Official per-model pricing table, per-model Monthly limit, the usage-window rule, the official 'Estimated requests' table, the landing-page Go model table and the privacy table were read as published. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed.
scope: OpenCode Go official price table only. One catalog entry was added on 2026-10-24: the new paid model 'Kimi K3.1 Pro' (model id kimi-k3.1-pro). The landing page now carries the banner 'Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available in Go.' and the model counter moved from 'View all 29 models' to 'View all 30 models'. No leaderboard/score data, no Command Code GOAT value changed (cross-channel note only), no shared-pool figure restated, no adopted.csv row, no computed allowance in this file.
adoptionStatus: research-only; not adopted; no opencode_go × kimi-k3.1-pro row in adopted.csv yet — adding one requires an OPENCODE_GO_MODELS entry in scripts/build_adopted.py, left to maintainer review
